subject: DEFINE directive
notes: kb/Work PB1367. SR2 reaches the PARAMETER alternative: a no-OVERRIDE PARAMETER redefinition of a defined name with no environment value, or a different one, is COBOL1618. A value-less PARAMETER DEFINE of a never-defined name stays not-defined (GR4); whether it 'declares' the name for a later plain DEFINE is left as before (interpretive edge recorded on the note).
